derivation:
by
  intro i j
  simpa only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, hΔ] using (e.symm.sum_comp fun k => M (e.symm i) k ⊗ₜ[R] M k (e.symm j)).symm
explanation: After unfolding reindexing and rewriting with hΔ, this is finite-sum invariance under e.symm, specialized to the tensor-product-valued summand. Equiv.sum_comp is generated by to_additive from Equiv.prod_comp.
